normalIntro.en: These hooks start with a box carried out of a door and end with a closed case.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从抱着纸箱出门开始，落到一件被了结的事。

normal.en: Dis- plus miss: send the person away.
normal.cn: dis 加 miss，把人送走。

normal.en: A dismissed worker keeps the key for one more hour.
normal.cn: 被解雇的工人还能拿着钥匙一小时。

normal.en: To dismiss a warning is to lend it a later voice.
normal.cn: 把警告打发掉，等于留给它更大的声音。

normal.en: The bell dismisses a class faster than any sentence.
normal.cn: 铃声比任何一句话都能更快地下课。

normal.en: A case dismissed is not a case forgotten.
normal.cn: 被驳回的案子，不等于被忘记。

abstract.en: Picture a box carried out in both arms.
abstract.cn: 想象一只纸箱被两只手抱出去。

abstract.en: Picture a hand waved toward the open door.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手朝开着的门挥了挥。

abstract.en: Picture a file closed with one flat palm.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手掌把档案合上。

examples.en: The manager dismissed two workers without warning.
examples.cn: 经理毫无预警地解雇了两名工人。

examples.en: She dismissed the rumour with a short laugh.
examples.cn: 她笑了一声就把那个传闻打发了。

examples.en: The class was dismissed ten minutes early.
examples.cn: 全班提前十分钟下课。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 dismiss 记成「送走」：dis 是分开，miss 是送，把人往各处送走就是解散；把人从位子上送走就是解雇。

root: 源自拉丁语 dimittere（遣散），由 dis-（分开）与 mittere（送、放）构成，经古法语 desmettre 进入英语。本义是让一群人各自散去，后来引申为解除职位，再引申为把一个想法或案子打发掉。

sensesIntro.en: From sending a crowd home to sending an idea out of the room.
sensesIntro.cn: 从把一群人送回家，到把一个想法赶出屋子。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a door opened and a box carried out in both arms.
core.cn: 核心意象：门开了，一只纸箱被双手抱出去。

chain: A NAME IS ON THE LIST

branches.en: The first sense is a person sent from a post.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是一个人被从职位上送走。

branches.en: The second sense sends an idea away instead.
branches.cn: 第二个义项送走的是一个想法。

branches.en: The third sense sends a whole group home.
branches.cn: 第三个义项把一整群人送回家。

branches.en: All three senses share one gesture of sending away.
branches.cn: 三个义项共有一个「送走」的动作。

branches.en: Both can be done politely, with a word and a nod.
branches.cn: 第一个与第三个义项都能礼貌地完成。

intro.en: Dismiss belongs to the Latin mittere family, where sending and letting go share one stem.
intro.cn: dismiss 属于拉丁语 mittere 一族，送出与放走共用同一词干。

latinIntro.en: Latin mittere, to send, gives dimittere and then dismiss, with dis- marking the sending apart.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 mittere（送）给出 dimittere，再成为 dismiss，前缀 dis- 标出「分送各处」。

items.exampleCN: 他的解雇通知寄了封信来。

items.example: He spoke dismissively of the plan.
items.exampleCN: 他轻蔑地谈起这个计划。

items.meaning: in the act of sending away
able to be removed from a post
items.example: The post was not dismissible at will.
items.exampleCN: 这个职位不能随意解职。

items.meaning: a sending out with a purpose

definition_en: a state in which things are not in order, or an illness of body or mind
core_image: 一屋子椅子全翻了，没有一把在原位
scene: 椅子全被推翻，桌上的纸页散了一地。The room was left in complete disorder.
sceneCN: 这里 disorder 指「混乱」（第 1 个义项：没有秩序的状态）；句意是房间被弄得一片混乱。

senses.title: A lack of order
senses.definition: a state in which things are not arranged or controlled
senses.definitionCN: 事物没有排列好或失去控制的状态
senses.example: The room was in complete disorder.
senses.exampleCN: 房间一片混乱。
senses.why: Chairs on their backs draw a map of a hurried exit.
senses.whyCN: 翻倒的椅子，画出一张匆忙离开的地图。

senses.title: An illness of body or mind
senses.definition: an illness that affects the normal working of the body or mind
senses.definitionCN: 影响身体或精神正常运作的病症
senses.example: He was treated for a sleep disorder.
senses.exampleCN: 他因睡眠失调接受治疗。
senses.why: A system out of order inside a body is still called disorder.
senses.whyCN: 身体里失去秩序的系统，也叫失调。

intro.en: Disorder is dis- plus order, from Old French desordre and Latin ordo, a row or arrangement.
intro.cn: disorder 是 dis- 加 order；order 经古法语 desordre 上溯拉丁语 ordo（行列、排列）。

items.en: Ordo meant a row, a rank or an arrangement.
items.cn: ordo 指行列、等级或排列。

items.en: Dis- before a noun marked the loss of that arrangement.
items.cn: 名词前的 dis- 标出这种排列的失去。

items.en: Desordre meant confusion and lack of order.
items.cn: 古法语 desordre 指杂乱与失序。

items.en: English used it for a broken arrangement of things.
items.cn: 英语用来指事物排列被打乱。

items.en: Medicine gave it the sense of a body system out of step.
items.cn: 医学又给了它身体系统失调这一义。

note.en: The look-alike group is built on order, and the meaning group names other states of confusion.
note.cn: 形近组围绕 order 构成，近义组列出别的混乱状态。

entries.definition: an arrangement or a command
not working in a normal way
noisy and hard to control
a state of complete confusion
a state where nothing is clear
a problem of the body or mind

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with a chair on its back and end with a body out of rhythm.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从一把翻倒的椅子开始，落到一具失去节奏的身体。

normal.en: Dis- plus order: order is gone.
normal.cn: dis 加 order，秩序没了。

normal.en: One fallen chair is an accident; ten are a disorder.
normal.cn: 一把椅子倒下是意外，十把倒下就是混乱。

normal.en: A desk in disorder hides the one paper you need.
normal.cn: 乱桌上总藏着你要的那一张纸。

normal.en: A sleep disorder is a clock inside the body gone wrong.
normal.cn: 睡眠失调，是身体里的钟走错了。

normal.en: Disorder in a street is a matter for the police.
normal.cn: 街上的秩序混乱，要交给警察。

abstract.en: Picture ten chairs lying on their sides.
abstract.cn: 想象十把椅子侧倒在地上。

abstract.en: Picture papers spread from desk to door.
abstract.cn: 想象纸页从桌边铺到门口。

abstract.en: Picture a clock with hands moving at odd speeds.
abstract.cn: 想象一只钟的指针快慢失常。

examples.en: The room was left in complete disorder.
examples.cn: 房间被弄得一片混乱。

examples.en: He is being treated for a sleep disorder.
examples.cn: 他正在接受睡眠失调的治疗。

examples.en: The storm threw the whole schedule into disorder.
examples.cn: 暴风雨把整个日程打乱了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 disorder 记成「没有次序」：dis 是否定，order 是秩序；东西不在次序里就是混乱，身体里的次序乱了就是失调。

root: 由否定前缀 dis- 加名词 order 构成；order 来自拉丁语 ordo（行列、排列），经古法语 ordre 进入英语。本义是排列被打乱，后来医学又用它指身体或精神系统失去正常节律。

sensesIntro.en: From a room out of order to a body out of step with itself.
sensesIntro.cn: 从一个失序的房间，到一具与自身节奏错开的身体。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: chairs on their backs and papers across the floor.
core.cn: 核心意象：椅子翻倒，纸页铺满地面。

branches.en: The first sense is the room that has lost its plan.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是失去布局的房间。

branches.en: The second sense is the body that has lost its rhythm.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是失去节律的身体。

branches.en: Both senses describe a system without its usual order.
branches.cn: 两个义项都形容失去平常秩序的系统。

branches.en: Both can be caused by one sudden event.
branches.cn: 两个义项都可能由一件突发的事引起。

branches.en: Only the second sense is treated by a doctor.
branches.cn: 只有第二个义项由医生处理。

intro.en: Disorder stands opposite order, inside the Latin ordo family of rows and ranks.
intro.cn: disorder 与 order 相对，属于拉丁语 ordo（行列与等级）一族。

latinIntro.en: Latin ordo, a row or arrangement, gives order; the prefix dis- removes the arrangement.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 ordo（行列、排列）给出 order，前缀 dis- 把排列拿走。

items.example: A disorderly crowd filled the square.
items.exampleCN: 一群喧闹失控的人挤满广场。

items.example: The disorderliness of the desk was famous.
items.exampleCN: 那张桌子的凌乱很出名。

items.example: An ordered row of jars stood on the shelf.
items.exampleCN: 架子上排着一列整齐的罐子。

items.example: She reordered the shelves by height.
items.exampleCN: 她按高度重新排了架子。

items.example: The queue moved in an orderly way.

definition_en: to put something where people can see it, or to show a feeling or quality
core_image: 玻璃柜里一排东西被灯照亮，标签朝外
scene: 玻璃柜里的灯刚亮起来，每一件东西都标签朝外。Her face displayed no sign of worry.
sceneCN: 这里 display 指「显示」（第 2 个义项：把情绪或特质表露出来）；句意是她脸上没有显出担忧。

senses.title: To put something out to be seen
senses.definition: to arrange something so that people can look at it
senses.definitionCN: 把东西摆出来供人观看
senses.example: The shop displays new bags in the window.
senses.exampleCN: 商店把新包展示在橱窗里。
senses.why: A lamp and a clean shelf do half the selling.
senses.whyCN: 一盏灯和一层干净的架子，就完成了一半的销售。

senses.title: To show a feeling or quality
senses.definition: to let a feeling or quality be seen
senses.definitionCN: 让某种情绪或特质显现出来
senses.example: Her face displayed no worry.
senses.exampleCN: 她脸上没有显出担忧。
senses.why: The body speaks before the mouth decides to.
senses.whyCN: 身体先说话，嘴还没决定要不要说。

senses.title: A screen that shows information
senses.definition: an electronic screen that shows information
senses.definitionCN: 显示信息的电子屏幕
senses.example: The display went dark.
senses.exampleCN: 显示屏黑了。
senses.why: A shop window shrank into a pane of light.
senses.whyCN: 橱窗缩成了一块发光的玻璃。

intro.en: Display comes from Latin displicare, to unfold, from dis- and plicare, to fold, through Old French despleier.
intro.cn: display 来自拉丁语 displicare（展开），由 dis- 与 plicare（折叠）构成，经古法语 despleier 进入英语。

items.en: Plicare meant to fold something flat.
items.cn: plicare 指把东西折叠起来。

items.en: Displicare meant to unfold it again.
items.cn: displicare 指重新把它展开。

items.en: Despleier meant to spread out or unfurl.
items.cn: 古法语 despleier 指铺开、展旗。

items.en: English display meant to spread out a banner.
items.cn: 英语 display 最初指展开旗帜。

items.en: It now covers goods, feelings and lit screens.
items.cn: 今天它涵盖货物、情绪与发光的屏幕。

note.en: The look-alike group keeps the play-like ending, and the meaning group names other ways of showing.
note.cn: 形近组保留近似 play 的词尾，近义组列出别的展示方式。

entries.definition: to take part in a game or a performance
a second showing of a recorded action
put out where people can see it
to show something in a public place
to let something be seen
a flat surface that shows images

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with a lit glass case and end with a pane of light.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从一只亮起的玻璃柜开始，落到一块发光的平面。

normal.en: Dis- plus play: the folded thing is opened out.
normal.cn: dis 加 play，把折着的东西展开。

normal.en: A window display sells before any word is spoken.
normal.cn: 橱窗陈列在任何一句话之前就在卖货。

normal.en: A face can display what a mouth refuses to say.
normal.cn: 嘴不肯说的，脸可以先显示出来。

normal.en: The display on a phone is a window made of glass and light.
normal.cn: 手机的显示屏，是一扇玻璃与光做的窗。

normal.en: Goods on display are easier to want than to need.
normal.cn: 陈列着的货，容易让人想买，而不是需要。

abstract.en: Picture a lamp switched on above a glass shelf.
abstract.cn: 想象玻璃架上方的灯亮了。

abstract.en: Picture a hand turning a box so the label faces out.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手把盒子转得标签朝外。

abstract.en: Picture a small screen glowing in a dark room.
abstract.cn: 想象暗屋里一块小屏在发光。

examples.en: Her face displayed no sign of worry.
examples.cn: 她脸上没有显出担忧。

examples.en: The museum displays old maps in a long hall.
examples.cn: 博物馆在一条长廊里展示旧地图。

examples.en: The display on the machine showed an error.
examples.cn: 机器上的显示屏显示了错误。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 display 记成「摆开来看」：dis 表示展开，词根与折叠的拉丁词有关，把折起的东西摊开摆好，就是展示。

root: 源自拉丁语 displicare（展开），由 dis-（分开）与 plicare（折叠）构成，经古法语 despleier 进入英语。本义是把折起或卷起的东西摊开，所以有「摆出来给人看」的意思，后来指把情绪显在脸上，现代又指发光的显示屏。

sensesIntro.en: From a banner spread open in the air to a pane of light on a desk.
sensesIntro.cn: 从空中展开的旗帜，到桌上那块发光的平面。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a lit glass case with every label facing out.
core.cn: 核心意象：亮起的玻璃柜，每张标签都朝外。

branches.en: The first sense is an object spread out for the eyes.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是摆出来给眼睛看的物件。

branches.en: The second sense is a feeling laid open the same way.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是用同样方式摊开的情绪。

branches.en: The third sense is the glass that does the showing.
branches.cn: 第三个义项是替人展示的那块玻璃。

branches.en: Both senses depend on being looked at.
branches.cn: 两个义项都要被看见才成立。

branches.en: A face and a screen both show without sound.
branches.cn: 脸和屏幕都能无声地显示。

intro.en: Display belongs to the plicare family of folding, where unfold and employ share a root.
intro.cn: display 属于 plicare（折叠）一族，展开与使用共用同一个根。

latinIntro.en: Latin plicare, to fold, gives displicare and display, and the same stem hides in employ and reply.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 plicare（折叠）给出 displicare 与 display，同一词干也藏在 employ 与 reply 里。

items.example: They display the cups near the door.
items.exampleCN: 他们把杯子陈列在门边。

items.example: The maps were displayed in a hall.
He was displaying a rare calm.
The results are displayable on one page.
items.exampleCN: 结果可以展示在一页上。

items.meaning: a person or thing that shows
items.example: A small displayer held the price.
items.exampleCN: 一个小展示架托着价签。

items.meaning: a board used for showing notices
items.example: A display board stood by the gate.
The display window was full of hats.

definition_en: the act of getting rid of something, or the right to use something as you wish
core_image: 垃圾车把一桶东西倒进车厢，桶底朝天
scene: 垃圾车把桶举起来，桶底朝天倒了个干净。The safe disposal of waste costs the city a fortune.
sceneCN: 这里 disposal 指「处理」（第 1 个义项：把废弃物处理掉）；句意是安全处理垃圾花了这座城市一大笔钱。

senses.title: The act of getting rid of something
senses.definition: the act of throwing away or dealing with something unwanted
senses.definitionCN: 把不要的东西扔掉或加以处置的行为
senses.example: The disposal of waste costs money.
senses.exampleCN: 处理垃圾要花钱。
senses.why: A bin lifted upside down ends a long story.
senses.whyCN: 一只桶被倒过来，一段长故事就结束了。

senses.title: The right to use something
senses.definition: the power to use or decide about something
senses.definitionCN: 使用或决定某事的权力
senses.example: The car is at your disposal.
senses.exampleCN: 这辆车随你使用。
senses.why: What you may command is what has been placed in your hand.
senses.whyCN: 你能支配的，是放进你手里的东西。

intro.en: Disposal is dispose plus -al, and dispose comes from Latin disponere, to set out in order.
intro.cn: disposal 是 dispose 加 -al；dispose 源自拉丁语 disponere（分置、安排）。

items.en: Ponere meant to place or to put down.
items.cn: ponere 指放置、放下。

items.en: Disponere meant to set things out in their places.
items.cn: disponere 指把东西各自摆好。

items.en: Disposer meant to arrange or to settle a matter.
items.cn: 古法语 disposer 指安排或了结事情。

items.en: English dispose meant to arrange and later to get rid of.
items.cn: 英语 dispose 先指安排，后指处理掉。

items.en: Disposal now names both the act and the power to use.
items.cn: 今天 disposal 既指处理行为，也指使用权。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the dispose stem, and the meaning group names other forms of control.
note.cn: 形近组共享 dispose 词干，近义组列出别的处置与控制。

entries.definition: to get rid of something
made to be thrown away after use
willing or arranged in a way
the act of taking something away
the way something is dealt with
the power to decide about something

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with a bin turned upside down and end with a hand holding a key.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从被倒过来的垃圾桶开始，落到一只握着钥匙的手。

normal.en: Dis- plus posal: things are set apart and cleared.
normal.cn: dis 加 posal，把东西分开摆好再清走。

normal.en: Waste disposal is the quiet work behind a clean street.
normal.cn: 垃圾处理是干净街道背后的安静功夫。

normal.en: At your disposal means the thing is placed in your hand.
normal.cn: 供你支配，意思是东西已放进你手里。

normal.en: A disposal site is where a city hides its leftovers.
normal.cn: 处理场是一座城藏剩饭剩菜的地方。

normal.en: The safest disposal is often the slowest one.
normal.cn: 最安全的处理，往往是最慢的那种。

abstract.en: Picture a bin lifted above the truck.
abstract.cn: 想象一只桶被举到车斗上方。

abstract.en: Picture a lid falling shut on an empty can.
abstract.cn: 想象盖子落在空罐上。

abstract.en: Picture a key laid on a table by its owner.
abstract.cn: 想象主人把钥匙放在桌上。

examples.en: The safe disposal of waste costs the city a fortune.
examples.cn: 安全处理垃圾花了这座城市一大笔钱。

examples.en: The whole library is at your disposal.
examples.cn: 整个图书馆都随你使用。

examples.en: Old chemicals need careful disposal.
examples.cn: 旧化学品需要小心处理。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 disposal 记成「摆开处理」：dis 是分开放，pos 是放置，-al 是行为；把东西分开摆好再清掉，就是处理。

root: 由动词 dispose 加名词后缀 -al 构成；dispose 源自拉丁语 disponere（分置、安排），由 dis-（分开）与 ponere（放置）组成。本义是把东西分开摆好，后来引申为处理掉不要的东西，也指把某物交到别人手里任其支配。

sensesIntro.en: From setting things in their places to handing the key to someone else.
sensesIntro.cn: 从把东西各就各位，到把钥匙交到别人手里。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a bin lifted and turned upside down above a truck.
core.cn: 核心意象：垃圾桶被举起，在车斗上方倒过来。

branches.en: The first sense is the clearing away of what is unwanted.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是把不要的东西清走。

branches.en: The second sense is the power left in your hand.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是留在你手里的那份权力。

branches.en: Both senses start from things placed in order.
branches.cn: 两个义项都从东西被摆放整齐开始。

branches.en: Both appear in the phrase at your disposal.
branches.cn: 两个义项都能读进「供你支配」这句话。

branches.en: Only the second sense can be handed over.
branches.cn: 只有第二个义项能被交出去。

intro.en: Disposal belongs to the Latin ponere family, where placing and arranging share one stem.
intro.cn: disposal 属于拉丁语 ponere 一族，放置与安排共用同一词干。

latinIntro.en: Latin ponere, to place, gives disponere and dispose; -al turns the arranging into a noun.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 ponere（放置）给出 disponere 与 dispose；后缀 -al 把安排变成名词。

items.example: Waste disposal is a city duty.
items.exampleCN: 垃圾处理是城市的职责。

items.meaning: to set out or get rid of

items.exampleCN: 一次性杯子塞满了垃圾桶。

items.meaning: willing or placed in a way
to make someone likely in advance
items.example: Genes predispose some people to it.
items.exampleCN: 基因使一些人先有倾向。

items.example: The disposer hummed under the sink.
items.exampleCN: 水槽下的处理机嗡嗡响。

definition_en: to get rid of something, or to make someone likely to feel or act in a certain way
core_image: 一个人把旧箱子搬到门口，回头看了一眼空出来的角落
scene: 旧箱子被搬到门口，他回头看了一眼空出来的角落。They disposed of the old files before moving.
sceneCN: 这里 dispose 指「处理掉」（第 1 个义项：把不要的东西清走）；句意是搬家前他们把旧文件处理掉了。

senses.title: To get rid of something
senses.definition: to throw away or deal with something unwanted
senses.definitionCN: 把不要的东西扔掉或处置掉
senses.example: They disposed of the old files.
senses.exampleCN: 他们把旧文件处理掉了。
senses.why: A cleared corner is the first sign of a move.
senses.whyCN: 空出来的角落，是搬家的第一个信号。

senses.title: To make someone inclined
senses.definition: to make someone likely to feel or act in a certain way
senses.definitionCN: 使某人倾向于某种感受或行动
senses.example: The warm welcome disposed her to stay.
senses.exampleCN: 热情的欢迎使她愿意留下。
senses.why: A room can lean a mind before a word is spoken.
senses.whyCN: 屋子在开口之前，就能让心思偏过去。

intro.en: Dispose comes from Latin disponere, to set out in order, from dis- and ponere, to place.
intro.cn: dispose 来自拉丁语 disponere（分置、安排），由 dis- 与 ponere（放置）构成。

items.en: Ponere meant to place or put down.
items.cn: ponere 指放置、放下。

items.en: Disponere meant to set each thing in its own place.
items.cn: disponere 指把每样东西各摆其位。

items.en: Disposer meant to arrange or to settle.
items.cn: 古法语 disposer 指安排或了结。

items.en: English dispose added the sense of getting rid of.
items.cn: 英语 dispose 添上处理掉的意思。

items.en: The word now also leans a mind toward a choice.
items.cn: 今天它也指让心思偏向某个选择。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the dispose stem, and the meaning group names other ways of clearing or leaning.
note.cn: 形近组共享 dispose 词干，近义组列出别的清理与倾斜说法。

entries.definition: the act of clearing something away
willing or arranged in a certain way
a usual tendency of mind
to throw something away
to put something in the rubbish

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with a box at the door and end with a settled matter.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从门口的旧箱子开始，落到一件被了结的事。

normal.en: Dis- plus pose: things are set apart and settled.
normal.cn: dis 加 pose，把东西分开摆好并了结。

normal.en: A cleared room disposes of a hundred small doubts.
normal.cn: 清空的房间，处理掉一百个小疑虑。

normal.en: Dispose of waste before it disposes of the garden.
normal.cn: 趁垃圾还没毁掉花园，先处理掉它。

normal.en: A kind host disposes a guest to stay longer.
normal.cn: 好客的主人让客人愿意多坐一会。

normal.en: Disposed to help, she opened the door at once.
normal.cn: 她有意帮忙，立刻开了门。

abstract.en: Picture a box carried out and set on the step.
abstract.cn: 想象一只箱子被搬出去放在台阶上。

abstract.en: Picture a hand brushing dust from an empty shelf.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手把空架上的灰拂掉。

abstract.en: Picture a chair turned slightly toward the fire.
abstract.cn: 想象椅子微微转向炉火。

examples.en: They disposed of the old files before moving.
examples.cn: 搬家前他们把旧文件处理掉了。

examples.en: The warm welcome disposed her to stay.
examples.cn: 热情的欢迎使她愿意留下。

examples.en: Please dispose of your rubbish properly.
examples.cn: 请妥善处理你的垃圾。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 dispose 记成「分开摆好」：dis 是分开，pos 是放置，把东西分开放好，该留的留，该清的清，就是处理。

root: 源自拉丁语 disponere（分置、安排），由 dis-（分开）与 ponere（放置）组成，经古法语 disposer 进入英语。本义是把东西各自摆好，后来引申为把不要的东西清出去，也指把心思摆向某一方。

sensesIntro.en: From setting each thing in its place to leaning a mind toward a choice.
sensesIntro.cn: 从把每样东西各就其位，到让心思偏向一个选择。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an old box carried to the door and an empty corner behind it.
core.cn: 核心意象：旧箱子被搬到门口，身后是一块空角落。

branches.en: The first sense is the sorting that ends in a bin.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是终于进了垃圾桶的分拣。

branches.en: The second sense is the sorting of a mind.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是心思的分拣。

branches.en: Both senses begin by placing things apart.
branches.cn: 两个义项都从把东西分开放开始。

branches.en: Both leave the space clearer than before.
branches.cn: 两个义项都让空间比原先清爽。

branches.en: Only the second sense happens without hands.
branches.cn: 只有第二个义项不用动手。

intro.en: Dispose belongs to the Latin ponere family, with disposal, disposition and predispose around it.
intro.cn: dispose 属于拉丁语 ponere 一族，周围有 disposal、disposition 与 predispose。

latinIntro.en: Latin ponere, to place, gives disponere and dispose, and the prefix marks setting things apart.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 ponere（放置）给出 disponere 与 dispose，前缀标出把东西分开摆放。

items.meaning: to set out or get rid of
items.example: They disposed of the boxes at noon.
items.exampleCN: 他们中午把箱子处理掉了。

items.example: Disposal of the waste took a week.
items.exampleCN: 处理这些废物用了一周。

items.example: A disposable plate bent in his hand.
items.exampleCN: 一只一次性盘子在他手里弯了。

items.example: A quiet disposition suited the work.
items.exampleCN: 安静的性情适合这份工作。

items.example: Cold rooms predispose people to colds.

definition_en: a serious disagreement, or to argue that something is not true
core_image: 两个人隔着一张桌子，各按着同一张纸的一角
scene: 两个人隔着一张桌子，各自按住同一张纸的一角。The two families have been in dispute for years.
sceneCN: 这里 dispute 指「争端」（第 1 个义项：长期未决的争执）；句意是这两家已经争了多年。

senses.title: A serious disagreement
senses.definition: a serious disagreement that lasts or becomes public
senses.definitionCN: 持续或公开的严重分歧
senses.example: The two families have been in dispute for years.
senses.exampleCN: 这两家已经争了多年。
senses.why: One sheet of paper, two hands, no shared edge.
senses.whyCN: 一张纸，两只手，找不到共同的一边。

senses.title: To argue that something is false
senses.definition: to say that something is not true or not right
senses.definitionCN: 声称某事不真实或不对
senses.example: He disputed the amount on the bill.
senses.exampleCN: 他质疑账单上的金额。
senses.why: To dispute is to hold the paper and pull.
senses.whyCN: 质疑，就是按住那张纸往回拉。

intro.en: Dispute comes from Latin disputare, to argue a question, from dis- and putare, to think or reckon.
intro.cn: dispute 来自拉丁语 disputare（辩论一个问题），由 dis- 与 putare（思考、计算）构成。

items.en: Putare meant to think, to reckon or to prune.
items.cn: putare 指思考、计算，也指修剪。

items.en: Disputare meant to reckon a matter from both sides.
items.cn: disputare 指把事情两面都算一遍。

items.en: Disputer meant to argue or to quarrel.
items.cn: 古法语 disputer 指辩论或争吵。

items.en: English dispute named a formal argument.
items.cn: 英语 dispute 指正式的辩论。

items.en: It now also means to question a fact or a bill.
items.cn: 今天它也指对事实或账单提出质疑。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the dispute stem, and the meaning group names other forms of conflict.
note.cn: 形近组共享 dispute 词干，近义组列出别的冲突形式。

entries.definition: open to argument
a person who argues a case
argued about by others
a heated exchange of views
an angry disagreement between people
entries.definitionCN: 人与人之间带怒气的争执

entries.definition: a call to prove or defend something
entries.definitionCN: 要求证明或辩护的挑战

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with two hands on one sheet and end with a paper finally settled.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从两只手按住一张纸开始，落到一张终于说定的纸。

normal.en: Dis- plus pute: two sides reckon the same sum apart.
normal.cn: dis 加 pute，两方各算一遍同一笔账。

normal.en: A dispute over pay can stop a whole factory.
normal.cn: 薪酬上的争执，能让整座工厂停下。

normal.en: The land in dispute has no fence left standing.
normal.cn: 有争议的那块地，篱笆早没了。

normal.en: To dispute a bill is to ask for the sum again.
normal.cn: 质疑一张账单，就是要求再算一遍。

normal.en: An undisputed fact needs no loud voice.
normal.cn: 无可争议的事实，不需要大声。

abstract.en: Picture two hands pulling opposite corners.
abstract.cn: 想象两只手各拉一角。

abstract.en: Picture a torn edge between two people.
abstract.cn: 想象两人中间一道撕开的边。

abstract.en: Picture a third chair brought to the table.
abstract.cn: 想象桌边多搬来一把椅子。

examples.en: The two families have been in dispute for years.
examples.cn: 这两家已经争了多年。

examples.en: He disputed the amount on the bill.
examples.cn: 他质疑账单上的金额。

examples.en: The land is still in dispute between the villages.
examples.cn: 这块地仍在两村之间争执不下。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 dispute 记成「各算各的」：dis 是分开，put 与思考、计算同源；两个人分开各算一遍，算不到一处，就成了争端。

root: 源自拉丁语 disputare（辩论一个问题），由 dis-（分开）与 putare（思考、计算、修剪）构成，经古法语 disputer 进入英语。本义是两方各自把账算一遍，因此既指争执本身，也指对某个说法提出质疑。

sensesIntro.en: From two separate reckonings of one sum to the argument that follows.
sensesIntro.cn: 从对同一笔账的两次计算，到随之而来的争执。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two hands on opposite corners of one sheet of paper.
core.cn: 核心意象：两只手按着同一张纸相对的两角。

branches.en: The first sense is the long disagreement itself.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是那场长期的分歧。

branches.en: The second sense is the act of pulling at one fact.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是对某个事实的拉扯。

branches.en: Both senses need at least two sides.
branches.cn: 两个义项都至少需要两方。

branches.en: Both can end when someone reads the paper again.
branches.cn: 两个义项都可能在有人重读那张纸时结束。

branches.en: Only the second sense can be done by one person alone.
branches.cn: 只有第二个义项能由一个人单独完成。

intro.en: Dispute belongs to the Latin putare family, where thinking, reckoning and arguing share a stem.
intro.cn: dispute 属于拉丁语 putare 一族，思考、计算与争辩共用同一词干。

latinIntro.en: Latin putare, to reckon, gives disputare and dispute, with dis- marking two separate reckonings.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 putare（计算）给出 disputare 与 dispute，前缀 dis- 标出两次分开的计算。

items.example: They dispute the price every year.
items.exampleCN: 他们每年都为价格争执。
有争议的边界仍然关闭。

items.example: Two clerks stood disputing the sum.
items.exampleCN: 两名职员站着争那笔钱。

items.example: A disputatious mind enjoys a quarrel.
items.exampleCN: 爱争辩的头脑喜欢争吵。
